patch.summary:
Choose GoTo Connect only if your buying job matches “Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact C” rather than respond.io's shape. Choose respond.io only if your buying job matches “Omnichannel customer messaging platform (WhatsApp + other channels) with shared inbox and ” rather than GoTo Connect's shape. Workflow advantage: GoTo Connect leans business-phone, team-communication; respond.io leans customer-messaging, whatsapp-support. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: GoTo Connect is Remote-team UCaaS phone system with meetings and messaging — Phone System / CX / Contact Center ladders are custom-quote (no public seat dol; respond.io is Omnichannel customer messaging platform (WhatsApp + other channels) with shared inbox and AI — Starter from $79/month annual-equivalent..
- Company-size focus: GoTo Connect (small-business, mid-market) vs respond.io (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: GoTo Connect-leaning business-phone, team-communication, contact-center vs respond.io-leaning customer-messaging, whatsapp-support.
- Researched limits: GoTo Connect — No published self-serve seat dollars — every plan is sales-quoted; respond.io — Not a business phone system — no IVR, queues or PSTN calling product.
